newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil's Santos port.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil's Santos port.

text.p: Santos port reported the following conditions for shipments of soybeans and soymeal.

Vessels: Tomis Future to complete loading 50,000 tonnes soybeans/soymeal and leave today. Ziemia Krakowska, previously loading soymeal at another berth, will take Tomis Future place's to finish loading 19,000 tonnes soymeal.
Waiting in the bay, expected: Merini arrived 08/03, waiting cargo to load 30,000 soymeal. Osso Lineum expected on 14/03 to take 55,000 soybeans and Mentese on 16/03 to take 47,000 soybeans.
Road: 280 trucks arrived on Thursday carrying total of 7,288 tonnes of which 15 trucks (1,390 tonnes) were soymeal. Remaining tonnage soybeans.
Rail: 33 trucks arrived Thursday (1,588 tonnes), all soymeal
